sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- Ukraine Air Force, morning report Nov 1] From 18:00 Oct 31, Russia attacked with 433 strike drones (64 jet-powered Shaheds, plus Gerbera and Parodiya decoy types) launched from Oryol, Kursk, Shatalovo, Bryansk, Millerovo and occupied Donetsk. As of 07:30 Nov 1, air defences shot down or suppressed 371 (47 jet-powered Shaheds among them); 40+ strike drones still airborne, combat ongoing. Hits recorded at 16 locations, debris falls at 14. [VERIFIED FACT -- location reports] Explosions heard in Kyiv; a drone crash in Kyiv's Desnianskyi district on the evening of Oct 31 started a fire in a non-residential area and set parked cars alight. [ATTRIBUTED -- presidential adviser Serhii 'Flash' Beskrestnov via NV] Solid cloud cover over Ukraine lets Russia launch dozens of gasoline-powered Shaheds that interceptor crews detect with more difficulty.
sections.what_verified: Two tiered families relay the same Air Force morning report: Ukrainska Pravda (T3) and NV (T3). ua.news carries the identical Air Force figures but is untiered in the registry and is NOT counted. No wire (Reuters/AP/AFP) confirmation of the 433 figure was located in-window; a targeted Reuters search returned no results. Both counted families share one origin (the Air Force report), so this is strong single-origin reporting, not two independent observations.
sections.what_disputed: Russian side has not confirmed scale or targets; hit locations and damage beyond Kyiv/Desnianskyi are unconfirmed by independent sources. The 371/433 interception ratio is the Air Force's preliminary figure at 07:30 and was explicitly subject to revision as 40+ drones remained airborne. Daytime Oct 31 wave (168 drones, 122 neutralised per Air Force via OSNT brief) is a separate wave, not part of this count.
sections.why_matters: 433 drones, 371 downed: the overnight wave in one counted number -- and the 16 places it still got through.
sections.context: Background: Ukraine -- Russia launches 433 drones overnight Oct 31-Nov 1; Air Force says 371 downed, hits at 16 locations; Kyiv explosions, Desnianskyi fire

totw_analysis: Our read: 433 drones, 371 downed: the overnight wave in one counted number -- and the 16 places it still got through. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Shield holding or saturation coming? 371 downed vs 16 hits -- air defence coping, or jet-Shaheds and cloud cover eroding it?
